headline: Committee to hold executive session to screen applicants for City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.
summary: The committee will meet in executive session to review and interview applicants for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position, then reconvene in open session to announce a finalist and schedule finalist interviews with the full City Council.
items: Executive session to consider or interview applicants for the Budget/Management Analyst position
Announcement of finalist for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position
Announcement of dates for finalist interviews with the full City Council
location: Beverly Public Library — Fogg Room, 32 Essex Street, Beverly, MA 01915
transcript:
# BEVERLY CITY COUNCIL
# BUDGET/MANAGEMENT ANALYST PRELIMINARY SCREENING COMMITTEE

Wednesday October 14, 2026 2:30pm
Beverly Public Library — Fogg Room
32 Essex Street, Beverly, MA 01915

## AGENDA

A. Regular/Open Session

B. Call to Order

C. Proposed Executive Session pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(8), to consider or interview applicants for employment by a preliminary screening committee, if the Chair declares that an open meeting will have a detrimental effect in obtaining qualified applicants. Executive Session will be used to identify finalists for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.

D. The Committee will reconvene in Open Session.

E. Reconvened Open Session

F. Announcement of finalist for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.

G. Announcement of dates for finalist interviews with the full City Council.

Received and Recorded, City Clerk's Office: 2026 OCT -9
